title: Coalesce overlapping unknown-kid JWKS refreshes
objective: Make the existing refresh lock a true single-flight boundary so validations overlapping one forced unknown-kid refresh reuse its result instead of starting a second sequential network cycle.

included: Add an in-memory refresh generation counter to SupabaseJwtValidator.
Capture the generation at validation start; after acquiring the existing lock, reuse the current manager without another refresh when that generation changed during the validation.
Increment the generation at forced-refresh start and completion in a finally block.
Retain the fresh pinned ConfigurationManager, refreshOnKeyMiss=false retry, exact metadata=2/JWKS=2 concurrent regression and all existing failure-path tests.
excluded: Changing trust policy, algorithms, issuer/audience/lifetime/subject/role validation, endpoints, cache intervals, HTTP transport, packages or response mapping.
Adding retries, timers, persistence, logging, external operations, live smoke, secrets, deployment or Git mutation.
Coalescing non-overlapping sequential validations or weakening exact request bounds.

acceptanceCriteria: Two deterministic overlapping unknown-kid validations return Invalid and perform aggregate metadata=2, JWKS=2.
One serial unknown-kid validation retains metadata=2, JWKS=2.
All other JWT valid, invalid, forbidden and unavailable tests remain unchanged and pass.
No token or key material is logged or persisted; full Release verification passes.
evidence: The deterministic async-gated concurrent regression observed metadata=3 after the redundant RequestRefresh deletion.
The current SemaphoreSlim serializes refresh bodies but does not tell a queued caller that a refresh completed while it waited.
rollbackPlan: Remove the generation counter and generation checks while retaining the already-approved redundant RequestRefresh deletion.
Do not weaken or remove the failing concurrency regression.
